name: alert
title: Alert
description: A message that stays on the page until it is dealt with: info, success, warning or error.

props.name: layout
props.description: `inline`: one centred row with 12px padding and the 28px close button, as in a PromptBar's `notice`.

props.name: icon
props.description: `false` hides the status icon; a node replaces it.

props.name: action
props.description: A Button or Link, or a few in a fragment.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows the close button; called when it is pressed.

StatusIcon.description: @internal The status glyphs from Figma (16px, 1.25 stroke), drawn in currentColor. Neutral uses the info glyph.

CloseIcon.description: @internal Shared by Satin's own components; not part of the public API and may change in any release.
